### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/form.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/form.md`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**11** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS), drawerSide (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm), drawerWidth (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm), modalSize (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm; a string literal in apply; a string literal in dataProps; a string literal in interactions))_
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`  _(via ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const), ObjectForm (symbol, a field of const object REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS), tabPosition (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via drawerWidth (literal, a string literal in ObjectForm))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in dataProps))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/form.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/form.md`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4d194464ce8cc8c3cfc85a8ebe332739cb113a14` — the merge of head `e17b04f7a7f7848c8fb41d55943552da8d0ccf6d` into base `9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4d194464ce8cc8c3cfc85a8ebe332739cb113a14 && git checkout 4d194464ce8cc8c3cfc85a8ebe332739cb113a14
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9 e17b04f7a7f7848c8fb41d55943552da8d0ccf6d && git checkout -B drift-repro 9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9 && git merge --no-ff e17b04f7a7f7848c8fb41d55943552da8d0ccf6d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9609c137efeff5823852c282089b69240af144a9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Inputs read: card #36544 body and all six comments (triage 7084472400, fold 7193096338, claim 7233564954, amendments 7233624584 and 7233916166, os-dev-report 7234867735); PR #38168 body, its two comments, its 23 files and the net diff from merge base 581ae76a; the 70 latest check-runs on the head: 60 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending.

### ① Derived judgments

- D1 `FormViewSchema.modalSize`, enum of five to a `retiredKey()` tombstone: right. The refusal stands at every door built from the shape: `FormViewSchema`, the container's `form` and `formViews.*`, both ViewItem form arms, the flattened form overlay, and `defineStack` (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`, 422). The message follows the five guidance conventions, and its `--from 18` sentence matches a key the schema accepted through 18.6.0.
- D2 `FormSchema` (the `form` item) refuses the key too: right. Its body is `FormViewSchema.shape` by reference less `data` (view.zod.ts, `formItemBodyShape`), so the second row `ui/Form:modalSize` is forced by the exact-key gate, as amendment 7233916166 accepted. The row is absent at tag 19.0.0-next.0 and live at 19.0.0-next.2, so no stable release ever published it.
- D3 TypeScript: `modalSize` is `never` at a `FormView` and a `Form` input position: right, pinned by two `@ts-expect-error` lines.
- D4 `ObjectFormPropsSchema.modalSize` (the `object-form` page block) unchanged: right. Its reader is live (`ObjectFormContainer.tsx` hands `schema.modalSize` to `ModalForm`, which uses an authored value as written).
- D5 React tier: `modalSize` leaves `ObjectForm` `dataProps`, joins `interactions` as a binding prop of the same type, and joins `REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS.ObjectForm`: right, the #29012 shape. The react accept set does not narrow: `validate-react-page-props` builds `knownProps` from `interactions` alone and parses no `ObjectForm` prop against `FormViewSchema`, so the prop goes from unlisted to known. The new description holds against the code: unset, `ModalForm` infers the size from the declared columns and the field count.
- D6 `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`: byte-for-byte what the generator emits, judged two ways. By reading `build-react-blocks-contract.ts` against the new index: the allow-list drops the data row; overlay props print in overlay order under a stable sort, so the new row lands between `drawerWidth` and `modalCloseButton`; its cells are the overlay's `type` with pipes escaped and the unclipped description; no other row reads `FormViewSchema.modalSize`. By the gate: `check:react-blocks` is a step of `Type Check · source gates`, green on this head.
- D7 D2 conversion `form-view-modal-size-removed` (`toMajor` 19, `retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter` 18.6.0): right. `apply` is the #29012 entry's walk (`mapViewPayloads`, then the assembled `viewItems` channel with the same config / flattened / malformed split) plus `mapCollection` over `forms`, the stack key `stack.zod.ts` declares. `stripKeys` makes it idempotent. `expectedNotices: 5` equals the keys removed. It never walks page components, so D4 survives a replay.
- D8 Registration order: right. The entry sorts by identifier between `agentModelProviderRemoved` and `knowledgeSourceContentFieldsToContent`, its import stands directly above its successor's, and `order: 4` is one above the highest. No other major-19 entry walks `views`, `viewItems` or `forms` (read: they walk `actions`, `objects`, page components, `agents`, `knowledgeSources`, `permissions`), so the order cannot change a result.
- D9 Registry tables: `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[19]` gains two rows, step 19 gains one D3 entry and one rationale sentence, file names follow `entries/README.md`: right.
- D10 The 18-era fixtures (`form-view-drawer-keys-removed`, `form-view-presentation-types-removed`): right, and forced. Every fixture replays through the whole table and must equal its own `after`; with `modalSize` left in as the bystander the new entry would strip it. `apply` is untouched in both files; only the bystander key (`tabPosition`, `columns`) and comments move.
- D11 The 18 D3 entry `ui-form-view-type-layout-only`, "(sized by `modalSize`)" to "and choose their own size": right. The package that ships this text refuses the key, so the old clause prescribed a refused key.
- D12 Liveness: `view.json` `form.modalSize` and `form.json` `modalSize` go live to dead and keep their rows: right for the tombstone route. The state counts move by exactly one row each (view 75 / 11, form 27 / 6 / 2) and `Spec property liveness` is green. Each claim of the note holds on the head tree: `FormPage.tsx` has 0 hits (control `submitBehavior`: 4); `resolveRecordFormModalLayout` writes only a derived `full`; `useActionModal.tsx` sets `modalSize: d.size` after a spread that carries no form view; no package outside `packages/spec` names the key except one lint explanation; `examples/` and `packages/apps` have 0 hits (control: 4 files).
- D13 `authorable-surface/ui.json`: two rows gain `[RETIRED]`, nothing else moves: right. A key-level narrowing leaves `api-surface` and the JSON-schema manifest untouched, and the def still emits.
- D14 Pins: the join row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`, the door, conversion and D3 describes, and the tree-scoped absence walk extended to `defineForm` literals with its own anti-vacuity test: right. The walk reuses the radius the package already declares.

### ② Semver level

The `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line stands on the PR body and in the changeset, and it is right: published schema narrows.

`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is right (a key tombstoned). `@objectstack/spec` minor is the level that kind takes: at least one package whose published source moves grades minor or above. `@objectstack/skills` patch is right: one generated row of the published bundle moves and no skill wording is authored. The changeset carries the BREAKING banner, the FROM → TO mapping, the one-line fix and exactly one adr-0087 marker, `registered` with the conversion id and the D3 id, both added by this diff. `Check Changeset`, the job that runs the level gate and the adr-0087 registration gate, is green. One sentence of the changeset is wrong on a date: see S1.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. `security_findings`: none; I found none.
- Dev flag 1, the `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` `view.form` row still scores `modalSize` as a failing row: accepted as a follow-up, but its cited authority is wrong. Seat ruling 7233916166 does not mention the checklist, and nothing carries the deferral except the PR body. See N2.
- Dev flag 2, the taxonomy comment in `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` still lists `modalSize` as spec-aligned: answered by ruling 7233916166 (declined, to keep `ui/` out). Accepted deviation; it shares N2's follow-up.
- Dev flag 3, the PR body's readings block promises seven gate re-runs and the dogfood battery in a comment: answered. Report 7234867735 carries them (126 derived, 126 run; battery exit 0 on this head).
- Claim, `Skills-docs:` line: present and true. The only `skills/**` text naming the key is the generated reference and two eval `must_not_contain` entries, which stay valid.
- Claim, serial constraint: still open. #37924 is not merged, and it edits `conversions/registry.ts`. The merge of `main` owed before the PR leaves draft moves this head; a merge is neither a pure regeneration nor prose-only, so this record does not carry over. The S1 delta can ride that head. Re-read the header sentence "and applies last" then.
- Claim, hotcrm: `main` authors the key six times, each under a container's default `form`, on spec 18.6.0. They meet the refusal at 19 and `os migrate meta --from 18 --write` deletes them. The claim routes them to hotcrm#2840. See S1 for what those six lose and when.
- Claim, `form.subforms`: out of this PR, on decision card #38140. Not touched by the diff.
- Escalated to the Tier H approver, not graded: the ruling of record for "retire" is the seat's, on the claim, and it argues from the missing reader. The playbook's test for a declared key with no consumer is whether a mainstream platform has the capability (maintainer ruling 5727134555), and the card does not record that test. My reading under ④ is that it passes.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
- PR author is the fleet relay account; no off-relay login to name.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing itself, against the published spec on `main`. `main` declares `modalSize` as "the dialog a caller opens this form in: the console's New / Edit dialog, or the modal container of the React `ObjectForm` block". Neither caller reads a form view on this tree. The record dialog builds its schema from the object (`AppContent.tsx`, `resolveRecordFormModalLayout`); a `type: 'form'` action routes to `/forms/NAME` (`ActionRunner.executeForm`); `FormPage.tsx` never names the key; the Studio canvas (`buildFormPreviewSchema`) and `plugin-view`'s form slot copy keys one by one and omit it; the block takes it as its own prop. So the PR takes no delivered capability away at a consumer: the delivery ended with #36425, whose changeset lists `modalSize` among what stops steering, and ADR-0050 already made a form's container the caller's concern. Retiring the declaration is the allowed route, and the block-level prop keeps the one live reader. The design holds. I could not break the door set, the conversion's reach or the fixture disjointness.

Per file: `view.zod.ts` holds (D1, D2). `react-blocks.ts` and the generated reference hold (D5, D6). The conversion and `registry.ts` hold (D7, D8). The two retired-key files and the template sentence hold (D9). The two 18 fixtures and the 18 D3 entry hold (D10, D11). The 19 D3 entry holds except for S1.

S1 (should-fix) — `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.ui-form-view-modal-size-retired.ts`, `reason`: "That dialog stopped loading a form view in 18 (the semantic entry `internal-record-forms-not-loaded`) ... a stored value saved, served and changed nothing." That is false for every released 18.x. At tag `@objectstack/spec@18.6.0` (commit 958ee035, 2026-11-18) `recordFormNavigation.ts` copies a form view's `modalSize` and `AppContent.tsx` lets the authored value win over the derived size. PR #36543 merged on 2026-11-22, 625 commits after that tag, and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` lists it under 19.0.0-next.0. 18.6.0 is this entry's own `retiredAfter` and the release hotcrm `main` runs with six authored values. It matters because of who reads the entry: `os migrate meta --from 18` composes the steps above 18 (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`), so an 18.6.0 app reads step 19 and never `internal-record-forms-not-loaded`, which sits in step 18. This entry is then the step-19 chain's only word on the dialog size that app loses, and it says the loss predates the upgrade. The same misdating is in the conversion's TSDoc ("stopped loading a form view in 18 (#36425)") and in the changeset ("Since 18 that dialog loads no form view ... drawn exactly as one without it"). Fix: date the end of the read to 19.0.0, name `internal-record-forms-not-loaded` as the protocol-18 entry that records it, and say that on 18.x the dialog took the authored size, so a form that carried the key opens at the derived size after the upgrade. The changeset sentence is a prose-face fix; the two `.ts` sites move the head. The tombstone message, the conversion `summary` and the step-19 rationale carry no date and stand.

N1 (nit) — at the `form` item door the refusal names `view.form.modalSize` to an author who wrote the key in `defineForm`. It follows from the by-reference shape, and the #29012 keys read the same there. Accepted deviation.

N2 (nit) — the two deferred edits (the QA checklist row and the `ui/` taxonomy comment) have no card; "noted, not filed" leaves them on the PR body alone. One follow-up card, filed by the seat.

N3 (nit) — `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (`form-view-internal-not-loaded`) and the 18 D3 entry `internal-record-forms-not-loaded` still list `modalSize` among keys that steer nothing. True as written; at 19 the key no longer parses, so the rule never meets it. Left as is.

No must-fix. One should-fix, S1, open on this head.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
